planDoc.meta: Growth plan · Your company · week one
planDoc.bet: Own the AI answers for “best payroll software for startups” within 90 days.
planDoc.betBody: Buyers now ask ChatGPT before they search. Today you appear in 6% of those answers and the leader in 12%. The fastest route is comparison and answer pages on the prompts your buyers already use.

months.work: Answer and comparison pages, new site pages

planDoc.measure: Share of AI answers, organic sign-ups and pipeline from organic, reported monthly.

note.body: Three comparison pages went live on Tuesday. Two of them are already cited by Perplexity, which is faster than we expected.
note.next: Brief the pricing comparison page and fix the two pages that dropped out of Google’s AI overview.
note.ask: Can your product lead review the payroll comparison by Wednesday?

report.headline: Your share of AI answers more than doubled, to 14.2%.
report.body: Most of the gain came in the four weeks after the answer pages went live. Comparison pages did the heavy lifting: they earned 7 of the 9 new citations in ChatGPT and Perplexity. Your strongest competitor held flat at 12%.
report.figure: Figure 1. Share of AI answers, weekly
report.recBody: They won 7 of 9 new citations. We would write six more, pause two blog posts a month, and show you the effect in the next report. Same hours, no new budget.

markup.figure: Figure 1 · Share of AI answers, weekly
markup.verdict: So: put month 3 into comparison pages. Same hours. – Arnel

plan.srText: How reporting works: a written growth plan in week one, a note from your strategist every Friday, and a monthly report with a recommendation you decide on together. The example shows a client whose share of AI answers rose from 6.1% to 14.2% in eight weeks.
